prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / cinematic environment concept.
DELIVERABLE: ONE COMPLETE EPIC LANDSCAPE SCENE, not a character sheet, not an isolated figure, not a collage, no UI. Wide 16:9 cinematic composition, ideally 2048x1152 or larger.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image1 is the PRIMARY ART DIRECTION for the WHOLE PICTURE INCLUDING THE CHARACTER. Match its cinematic space illustration, enormous celestial scale, layered rocky foreground, breathtaking luminous rings, warm rim lighting against deep cool space, and especially its small, simplified, painterly anime-like HUMAN. The human must be rendered in the SAME abstracted cinematic-illustration style as the tiny seated girl in image1, NOT as a photoreal cutout or detailed fashion render.
Image2 is ONLY an OUTFIT/HARACTER DESIGN guide, NOT a rendering-style reference. Retain the design but radically simplify its depiction at environmental scale.

SCENE:
A lonely Chinese young woman stands at the edge of a dark crystalline ice-and-basalt cliff in the lower-left third, facing RIGHT and away toward a colossal Saturn filling the upper center/right sky. Her height is ONLY about 15 percent of the entire frame. Full body, both hands tucked into jacket pockets, long straight black hair, calm slightly bowed head, quietly melancholy. The girl has a few elegant silhouette shapes, soft cel-painted planes, barely suggested Chinese side-profile features, no detailed eyelashes/skin pores or realistic portrait face. Shadow and warm rim light unite her with the landscape. Natural slim proportions; no doll/chibi, no giant anime eyes. She is small and emotionally powerful because the cosmos is enormous.

Her established outfit is preserved in simplified color shapes: relaxed oversized smooth exploration-fabric jacket with glacier-blue main panels, taro-lavender shoulder/sleeve blocks, pale-mint hem accents and ivory collar; wide ivory/light oat trousers; fashionable chunky off-white FILA sneakers with subtle pale lavender and silver panels. BOTH HANDS IN SIDE POCKETS. No backpack/bag, no cape/dress, no helmet. No animal companion — reference1's cat and backpack are not part of this character.

ENVIRONMENT:
Saturn is breathtakingly vast, its gently oblate gold/ochre body rising behind the horizon, layered atmospheric bands, cool blue-gray night hemisphere, precise sunlit crescent and dramatic terminator. Its broad ultra-thin ring plane sweeps diagonally across most of the sky and beyond both frame edges, thousands of fine layered icy ringlets with a clearly defined dark Cassini Division, believable ellipse perspective and physically coherent shadows on planet/rings. Take natural restrained planetary colors, scale, ring shadows and Cassini silhouette inspiration from NASA/JPL's film Cassini: The Wonder of Saturn. No neon cartoon rings.
A recognizably accurate Cassini spacecraft glides in the middle-distance to the RIGHT of the girl, gold foil bus, white high-gain dish, thin long instrument boom, RTGs, just a few percent of frame width, lit by the same low sunlight, NOT a giant spaceship or rocket with fire.
Foreground jagged frost-edged rock slopes away from girl into immense layered moon mountains and a low band of illuminated icy mist. Dramatic depth and leading lines, delicate mineral frost catches amber light. Soft gold sunlight grazes the far horizon, warm thin light on rock and character, cold deep navy shadows. Sparse fine stars and a restrained diagonal Milky Way of dusty blue, ivory and faint lavender give depth, a very small distant crescent moon. The sky occupies roughly 75% of the scene and overwhelms the tiny traveller. Awe, solitude, majestic silence, a still from a beautiful animated cosmic odyssey.

STYLE:
Whole scene a unified premium cinematic science-fiction illustration: realistic detailed celestial rendering combined with the simplified painterly film-character treatment from reference1. Strong compositional lighting, large masses, deep blacks, controlled amber glow, vast scale, exquisite but purposeful detail. Beautiful and epic, no pasted-on sharp photoreal person, no portrait lighting, no generic AI fantasy clutter. Do not copy reference1 exactly; create an original composition with the approved standing character.
Opaque full environment background. NO typography, watermark, border, layout grid, website buttons, character turnaround or isolated transparent subject.
